name: Tokumi Kyounosuke
source:
An easy going man who speaks in Kansai dialect. He is evasive and you can't know what he is thinking.

He met by chance the depressed main character who was doubting his wife at the park.

He is a detective belonging to the [Akane Detective Agency]

[Translated from [url=http://www.hendingerg.com/products/kasen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
